visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a man in a black beanie and black sweatshirt sitting in a high-back professional gaming chair. He is in a studio setting with shelves behind him displaying large robot figurines (Mazinger Z) and various tech boxes. He gestures with his hands while speaking. (2) The visual cuts to a gameplay sequence from 'Assassin's Creed Shadows' showing a character in dark shinobi attire walking through a Japanese garden with cherry blossoms and stone lanterns. (3) The shot transitions back to the man in the beanie, then quickly cuts to a shot of three people (two men and one woman) sitting at a white studio table, laughing and looking at a screen off-camera. (4) An in-game menu interface appears, showing a female character profile with equipment slots and stats. Text overlays describe the character as a 'Shinobi'. (5) The video continues with alternating shots of the studio panel and more gameplay footage, including character portraits of a large male warrior and the female shinobi. Yellow and white variety-style text overlays appear frequently throughout.

(5) [Subtitle]: 武士角色. [Subtitle]: 刺客角色. (6) [Variety]: 真的不太可行. (7) [Subtitle]: 探子：古代稱專門替人 探聽消息的人. (8) [Slogan]: 是金探子.
